title: Bitcoin hits lowest since July at $61.8K as the Dow sheds 1,000+ | Daily Brief
caption:
bitcoin sank to ~$61.8k, its lowest since early july 📉 anthropic's ipo popped (opened $111.50 vs $83), but fed hike talk and a wall street rout won. eth below $1,800, sol near $73, fear & greed 10. $324m liquidated in 24h, two thirds longs. btc etfs -$306m wednesday, eth etfs -$39.8m (3rd straight day). next week: pce + gdp wed, us markets closed thu. levels to watch: $60k support, $65k resistance. not financial advice.
